summary: A fake Web3 recruiter directed a developer to clone a malicious GitHub repository containing trojanized setup scripts that executed during installation to exfiltrate environment variables and run remote commands. The attackers also attempted to persuade the victim to connect a MetaMask wallet during the interview but the victim used a test wallet and avoided compromise.
user_mistake: Cloned and prepared to execute code from an untrusted repository during a fake job interview.
prevention: Review repositories before execution / Run untrusted projects inside an isolated environment
